scripts.postbuild: node -e "const f=require('fs');const o='public/ota-version.json';let v='3.0.0';if(f.existsSync(o)){const info=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync(o,'utf8'));v=info.appVersion||info.version||v;f.copyFileSync(o,'build/ota-version.json');console.log('[postbuild] ota-version copied')};const a='android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk';if(f.existsSync(a)){const d='releases';f.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});f.copyFileSync(a,d+'/ChatRoom-v'+v+'.apk');console.log('[postbuild] APK copied to releases/ChatRoom-v'+v+'.apk')}else{console.log('[postbuild] No APK found, skipping')}"
